working_title: Ecological assets behind improving accounts: a boundary-matched test of composition masking
status: Developing empirical study: bounded Brazil endpoint land-cover support alignment; national physical sample and change inference remain incomplete
account_vintage: NEFBA Edition 2026, results and metadata v1.0
pilot_candidate_basis: Deliberate logistical/environmental variety, not a probability sample; not selected using paired outcome signs. Candidates are not yet eligible empirical observations.
primary_analysis_requires: documented change uncertainty including temporal/spatial dependence
conversion_claim_requires: transition validation on a reference sample
deferred: soil/wetland/fish trend modules without fit-for-purpose repeat data
coarse_product_role: Coordinate and metadata inspection; no national stock or conversion estimates
analysis_components: Within-asset spatial compensation with measurement-error and effective-support assessment
prior_information_disclosure: Existing plans, literature, and world-level NFA audits were read. The source schema and first Afghan historical rows were inspected during source discovery; no new paired country endpoint changes were computed before this specification. This is not a pristine or externally registered preregistration. F04 subsequently inspected country-boundary geometry, a 2015 identifier inventory, product endpoint availability and valid/zero/missing native-cell counts in fixed local windows; no national physical stocks or change signs were estimated. During territory checking, single-year 2015 account forest-area and population values were also inspected; they were not used as independent forest validation or to compute paired country changes. Later source-discovery searches also exposed published third-party forest-trend headlines/statistics; candidate countries and probe locations were not changed. No outcome-naive source-selection or independent held-out-validation claim is made. F05 subsequently inspected the two MapBiomas Collection 11 cover arrays on the unchanged F04 Brazil window, their local category areas and endpoint patterns. Those observations are not an untouched held-out evaluation. Operational groups were frozen before decoding these arrays.
native_probe_role: Non-outcome-selected access and valid/no-data/zero support checks only; not national coverage, stock change or validation
physical_outcome_scope: Bounded mapped-cover endpoint areas only, not validated forest land use, national forest change or biomass stocks
